answer: Require agents to post a bond before accepting work, then earn reputation through verified deliveries; proven fraud lets customers slash the bond. A swarm of new identities starts with no history, so each sybil must lock fresh capital and spend a long horizon completing honest jobs before gaining trust. Shale credits can hold the bond, while a falcon monitor flags coordinated accounts. The attacker pays in capital and time, and risks losing the bond, though a patient, well-funded attacker may still succeed.
